summary: SPARK end-to-end test — first iteration. Backend: 25/25 pytest passed (auth, spatial data endpoints, role-guarded reports, simulate with Claude, streaming AI chat). Frontend: all 11 flows in scope verified via Playwright on the public preview URL. Real Claude (claude-sonnet-4-6 via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY) is really wired — /api/simulate returns a specific planning recommendation string and /api/ai/chat streams a structured EVIDENCE/ANALYSIS/PROJECTION/RECOMMENDATION reply visibly to the UI. Silent-fallback probe passed (LLM cited the correct in-system-prompt figure 42.8 t/mo). No critical or major issues found. Skills loaded: ai-testing-core, ai-testing-llm.
ai_feature_verdicts: AI Copilot chat (streaming Claude via /api/ai/chat) - pass - evidence: HTTP 200 text/plain stream, reply included EVIDENCE/ANALYSIS/PROJECTION/RECOMMENDATION headings; in-domain probe reply contained '42.8' (system-prompt number). See screenshot ai_chat.png. Skill: ai-testing-llm. (primary AI feature)

AI planning recommendation in Simulator (/api/simulate) - pass - evidence: HTTP 200; deterministic impacts match formula (25% pop + 800 housing + commercial => waste_increase_pct=40.8, verified in test_simulate_returns_impacts_and_ai_recommendation); returned recommendation string was >30 chars, real Claude prose (e.g. 'priority infrastructure investment should focus on establishing one new integrated waste transfer hub in Zone B (Dengkil/Cyberjaya Fringe)...'). Skill: ai-testing-llm.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py hard-codes ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD defaults in code (line 315-316). backend/.env already sets them, but leaving defaults in code is a subtle secret-exposure risk if .env is missing.
register endpoint returns 200 for success — conventionally 201 for resource creation. Non-blocking.
get_current_user still accepts cookie fallback (access_token) even though frontend uses Bearer only — harmless but dead code.
Overview.js has an inline 'Truck2 = MapPin' alias for a supposedly missing Truck icon (line 156). Cosmetic, but readers may be confused.
SepangMap layer toggles: not all planner screens expose data-testids on individual layer checkboxes — I saw 7 layer-* boxes, which matches spec.
Register.js form fields (Full name, Email, Password) lack data-testid attributes. Adds friction for automated tests. Suggested testids: register-name, register-email, register-password.
action_items: OPTIONAL: add data-testid to Register.js inputs (register-name, register-email, register-password) to unblock automated register-flow testing.
OPTIONAL: return HTTP 201 from POST /api/auth/register and POST /api/reports for REST correctness.
test_credentials: planner@spark.gov.my / Sepang2030 ; citizen@spark.my / citizen123 — both work; a test citizen was also registered via POST /api/auth/register.
seed_data_creation: Startup seeds planner + citizen admin users (server.py startup event). Tests created transient TEST_ report rows and 1 TEST_ registered user; safe to leave.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var (or run from a shell that exports it from frontend/.env). Streaming /api/ai/chat is plain text (not SSE data: events) read via response.body reader. AI is persona-locked to Sepang planning — off-topic probes get refused (this is not a bug); use in-domain probes for silent-fallback checks. Frontend nav uses data-testid='nav-01'..'nav-08'.
notes: Verified in browser: sidebar shows 8 numbered nav items (Overview, Spatial Intelligence, AI Analytics, Forecasting, Site Suitability, Logistics, Planning Simulator ★, Reports). All KPIs populated (59.1 t/mo, +18.4%, 67%, 04 hotspots). Leaflet CartoDB tiles load correctly with severity-colored circle markers. Simulator run with 20/20/500/commercial=ON produced projected_waste=78.6 t/mo, net_landfill=62.9 t/mo, and a coherent 4-sentence Claude recommendation naming Zone B / Dengkil-Cyberjaya Fringe.
